title: Microsoft says that Windows 11 Xbox mode, a controller-first, full-screen gaming interface, will begin rolling out in April and work across all PC form factors (Abhijith M B/Windows Latest)
summary: Abhijith M B / Windows Latest: Microsoft says that Windows 11 Xbox mode, a controller-first, full-screen gaming interface, will begin rolling out in April and work across all PC form factors — Microsoft has confirmed that Xbox mode is coming to Windows 11 PCs, heralding one of the biggest shifts in the company's gaming strategy in years.
